description: This file contains a JUnit test class that verifies the accessibility of the OpenAPI documentation endpoint in a Spring Boot application, ensuring it returns the correct status and content type without authentication.

classes.name: OpenApiDocsAccessibilityTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the accessibility and correctness of the OpenAPI JSON endpoint in the application.

methods.name: openApiDocsAreAccessibleWithoutAuthentication
